mock_data.title: Blood Transfusion Fears
mock_data.passage:
We are used to regarding blood transfusion as a process which saves lives. Now, there are fears that it may spread disease.

The president of the American Red Cross, Bernadette Healey, said recently that she would be afraid of having a blood transfusion in Britain, even as part of emergency treatment. She would be worried in case she contracted the disease known as vCJD, which is short for variant Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease.

Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease is a rare and fatal disease which affects the human brain. It has been suggested that the new variant form of it can be caused by eating meat taken from cattle suffering from BSE (short for bovine spongiform encephalopathy), and that vCJD is the human form of BSE. This disease was first identified in Britain in 1986 and is known as mad cow disease because cattle suffering from it keep staggering and falling down.

Much speculation and uncertainty surround how vCJD is contracted, but one thing is certain. No one has yet contracted the disease by means of a blood transfusion. Scientists do not yet know if this is even possible.

However, fears remain that blood donors who are infected with this disease, or who are carriers of it, might pass it on in their blood. The American Red Cross, which supplies about half the blood used in transfusions in the United States, recently placed a ban on blood donors who have lived in, or travelled in, Europe for more than six months.

Reducing stocks of blood is likely to cause problems for American doctors, since the country is already suffering from a chronic shortage of blood in its blood banks. More blood is being used since many modern medical and surgical procedures require a great deal of blood. On the other hand, fewer people seem to want to become blood donors.

Members of the British National Blood Service have defended the safety of its blood supplies, emphasizing the precautions which they have put in place, such as the screening of donors. However, people remember those who were infected with HIV by means of blood transfusions and the fear remains, however unfounded.

mock_data.passageB2:
We usually think of blood transfusions as a life-saving medical procedure. However, there are now growing concerns that they could potentially spread diseases.

Bernadette Healey, the president of the American Red Cross, recently stated that she would be hesitant to receive a blood transfusion in the UK, even in an emergency. Her worry stems from the possibility of contracting variant Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease (vCJD).

Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease is a rare and devastating disease that damages the brain. It's believed that the new variant, vCJD, can be caused by eating meat from cattle infected with Bovine Spongiform Encephalopathy (BSE), often called mad cow disease. BSE was first identified in Britain in 1986 and causes cattle to lose coordination and collapse.

There's a lot of speculation and uncertainty surrounding how vCJD is transmitted. So far, no one has contracted the disease through a blood transfusion. Scientists haven't even confirmed whether this is possible.

Despite this, fears persist that blood donors who are infected with vCJD, or who are carriers of the disease, could transmit it through their blood. The American Red Cross, which provides approximately half of the blood used for transfusions in the US, recently implemented a ban on blood donations from individuals who have lived in or travelled extensively in Europe for more than six months.

This reduction in blood supply is likely to create problems for American doctors, as the country already faces a chronic shortage of blood in its blood banks. The demand for blood is increasing because many modern medical and surgical procedures require significant amounts. At the same time, fewer people seem willing to donate blood.

The British National Blood Service has defended the safety of its blood supplies, highlighting the stringent measures they have in place, such as screening blood donors. However, the public remembers those who contracted HIV through blood transfusions, and this lingering fear remains, even if it's unsubstantiated. This situation highlights the need for vigilance and transparency regarding blood safety. It's a delicate balance between ensuring adequate blood supplies and maintaining public confidence in the system. We must also acknowledge the potential for new threats to blood safety to emerge. Proper research and testing are paramount to keeping the blood supply safe.
mock_data.passageC1:
While blood transfusions are generally revered as life-saving interventions, growing anxieties have surfaced concerning their potential role in transmitting infectious diseases. This apprehension has been amplified by recent pronouncements from prominent figures in the medical community.

Bernadette Healey, President of the American Red Cross, recently voiced reservations about receiving a blood transfusion in the UK, even in an emergency situation. Her concerns stemmed from the risk of contracting variant Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease (vCJD), a particularly virulent and debilitating neurological disorder.

Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease, in its various forms, is a rare and invariably fatal condition that precipitates rapid brain deterioration. The variant form, vCJD, has been linked to the consumption of meat from cattle afflicted with Bovine Spongiform Encephalopathy (BSE), commonly known as mad cow disease. BSE, which first emerged in Britain in 1986, causes infected animals to exhibit neurological impairment, leading to uncoordinated movements and eventual collapse.

Despite considerable research, the precise mechanisms of vCJD transmission remain shrouded in uncertainty. Crucially, there is currently no documented case of vCJD transmission via blood transfusion. Whether such transmission is even possible remains a question that eludes definitive scientific confirmation. However, the possibility, however remote, continues to fuel public anxiety.

The fear centres on the potential for asymptomatic carriers of vCJD to unknowingly donate blood, thereby introducing the pathogen into the blood supply. In response to these concerns, the American Red Cross, a major provider of blood for transfusions in the United States, has instituted a policy barring individuals who have resided in or travelled extensively in Europe from donating blood.

This restriction on potential donors threatens to exacerbate an already precarious situation. The United States is grappling with a persistent shortage of blood in its blood banks, a problem compounded by the increasing demand for blood in advanced medical and surgical procedures, coupled with a seemingly declining rate of voluntary blood donation. The interplay of these factors creates a challenging dynamic for healthcare providers.

The British National Blood Service has robustly defended the safety of its blood supplies, emphasizing the rigorous screening protocols and other precautionary measures in place to safeguard against contamination. Nonetheless, the collective memory of past instances, notably the transmission of HIV through blood transfusions, continues to cast a long shadow, fueling public unease despite assurances of safety. The challenge lies in reassuring the public that lessons have been learned and that the risk of similar incidents has been minimized, if not entirely eliminated, insofar as is humanly possible.

mock_data.translation:
Biz qon quyishni hayotni saqlaydigan jarayon deb bilishga odatlanganmiz. Endi u kasallik tarqatishi mumkinligidan qo'rqish bor.

Amerika Qizil Xoch rahbari Bernadet Xili yaqinda Britaniyada shoshilinch davolanishning bir qismi sifatida ham qon quyishdan qo'rqishini aytdi. U vCJD deb nomlanuvchi kasallikka chalinishidan xavotirlanadi, bu variant Kreytsfeldt-Yakob kasalligining qisqartmasi.

Kreytsfeldt-Yakob kasalligi inson miyasiga ta'sir qiluvchi noyob va o'limga olib keladigan kasallikdir. Uning yangi variant shakli BSE (bovine spongiform encephalopathy) dan aziyat chekayotgan qoramollarning go'shtini iste'mol qilish natijasida yuzaga kelishi mumkinligi ta'kidlangan va vCJD BSEning inson shaklidir. Bu kasallik birinchi marta 1986 yilda Britaniyada aniqlangan va jinni sigir kasalligi deb nomlanadi, chunki undan aziyat chekayotgan qoramollar dovdirab yiqilishda davom etadilar.

vCJDga qanday chalinishi haqida ko'p taxminlar va noaniqliklar mavjud, ammo bir narsa aniq. Hali hech kim qon quyish orqali bu kasallikka chalinmagan. Olimlar bu mumkinligini ham bilishmaydi.

Biroq, bu kasallik bilan kasallangan yoki uning tashuvchisi bo'lgan qon donorlarining uni qonida o'tkazishi mumkinligidan qo'rqish saqlanib qolmoqda. Amerika Qizil Xochi, AQShda qon quyishda ishlatilgan qonning taxminan yarmini ta'minlaydi, yaqinda Yevropada olti oydan ortiq yashagan yoki sayohat qilgan qon donorlariga taqiq qo'ydi.

Qon zaxiralarini kamaytirish amerikalik shifokorlar uchun muammolar keltirib chiqarishi mumkin, chunki mamlakat qon banklarida qonning surunkali tanqisligidan aziyat chekmoqda. Ko'proq qon ishlatilmoqda, chunki ko'plab zamonaviy tibbiy va jarrohlik muolajalar katta miqdorda qonni talab qiladi. Boshqa tomondan, kamroq odamlar qon donorlari bo'lishni xohlayotganga o'xshaydi.

Britaniya Milliy Qon Xizmati a'zolari o'z qon zaxiralarining xavfsizligini himoya qildilar, ular joriy qilgan ehtiyot choralarini, masalan, donorlarni skrining qilishni ta'kidladilar. Biroq, odamlar qon quyish orqali OIVga chalinganlarga esda qolmoqda va qo'rquv saqlanib qolmoqda, qanchalik asossiz bo'lmasin.

mock_data.translationB1:
Odatda, qon quyish hayotni saqlab qoladi deb o'ylaymiz. Ammo hozir, ba'zi odamlar bu kasalliklarni tarqatishi mumkinligidan xavotirda.

Amerika Qizil Xoch jamiyatining rahbari Bernadett Xili yaqinda Britaniyada qon quyishdan qo'rqishini aytdi. U buni hatto favqulodda vaziyat bo'lsa ham aytdi. U vKJD deb nomlangan kasallikka chalinishdan xavotirda, bu variant Kreytzfeldt-Yakob kasalligining qisqartmasi.

Kreytzfeldt-Yakob kasalligi miyaga ta'sir qiluvchi kam uchraydigan va jiddiy kasallikdir. Ba'zi odamlar uning yangi turi, vKJD, BSE (mol shimgichsimon ensefalopatiyasi) bilan kasallangan sigirlarning go'shtini iste'mol qilish natijasida kelib chiqishi mumkin deb o'ylashadi. BSE - sigirlardagi kasallik, vKJD esa odamlardagi shu kasallik deb hisoblanadi. BSE birinchi marta 1986 yilda Britaniyada topilgan va sigirlar gangirab yiqilib tushgani sababli "jinni sigir kasalligi" sifatida tanilgan.

Odamlar vKJDni qanday yuqtirib olishi haqida ko'plab noaniqliklar mavjud. Ammo biz bir narsani aniq bilamiz: hali hech kim qon quyishdan bu kasallikka chalinmagan. Olimlar buni mumkinmi yo'qmi, bilishmaydi ham.

Biroq, ba'zi odamlar hali ham xavotirda. Ular kasallikka chalingan yoki uni tashuvchi qon donorlari uni qon orqali yuqtirishi mumkin deb o'ylashadi. Qo'shma Shtatlarda qon quyish uchun ishlatiladigan qonning yarmini beradigan Amerika Qizil Xoch jamiyati, Yevropada olti oydan ortiq yashagan odamlarga qon topshirishni taqiqladi.

Agar qon kamroq bo'lsa, bu Amerikadagi shifokorlar uchun muammolarni keltirib chiqarishi mumkin. Mamlakatda allaqachon qon taqchilligi mavjud. Ko'proq qon ishlatilmoqda, chunki ko'plab tibbiy muolajalar ko'p qonni talab qiladi. Shuningdek, kamroq odamlar qon berishni xohlamoqda.

Britaniya Milliy Qon Xizmati ularning qoni xavfsiz ekanligini aytadi. Ular donorlarni tekshirish kabi ehtiyot choralarini ko'rganliklarini aytishadi. Ammo odamlar qon quyishdan OIVni yuqtirgan paytlarni eslashadi. Qo'rquv asossiz bo'lsa ham, saqlanib qoladi.
mock_data.translationB2:
Odatda qon quyishni hayotni saqlab qoluvchi tibbiy muolaja deb o'ylaymiz. Biroq, hozirda uning kasalliklarni tarqatish ehtimoli borligi haqida tobora ko'proq xavotirlar mavjud.

Amerika Qizil Xoch jamiyatining prezidenti Bernadette Healey yaqinda hatto favqulodda vaziyatda ham Buyuk Britaniyada qon quyishni olishga ikkilanishini aytdi. Uning xavotiriga variant Creutzfeldt-Jakob kasalligini (vCJD) yuqtirib olish ehtimoli sabab bo'lgan.

Creutzfeldt-Jakob kasalligi miyaga zarar yetkazadigan kam uchraydigan va vayronkor kasallikdir. Yangi varianti, vCJD, Bovine Spongiform Encephalopathy (BSE) bilan kasallangan qoramollarning go'shtini iste'mol qilish natijasida kelib chiqishi mumkin deb ishoniladi. BSE birinchi marta Britaniyada 1986 yilda aniqlangan va qoramollarning muvofiqlashtiruvini yo'qotishiga va qulashiga olib keladi.

vCJD qanday yuqishi haqida juda ko'p taxminlar va noaniqliklar mavjud. Hozircha hech kim qon quyish orqali kasallikka chalinmagan. Olimlar hatto buni mumkinligini ham tasdiqlashmagan.

Shunga qaramay, vCJD bilan kasallangan yoki kasallik tashuvchisi bo'lgan qon donorlari uni qon orqali yuqtirishi mumkin degan qo'rquv saqlanib qolmoqda. AQShda qon quyish uchun ishlatiladigan qonning taxminan yarmini ta'minlovchi Amerika Qizil Xoch jamiyati yaqinda Yevropada olti oydan ortiq yashagan yoki ko'p sayohat qilgan shaxslardan qon topshirishni taqiqladi.

Qon ta'minotining bu qisqarishi amerikalik shifokorlar uchun muammolarni keltirib chiqarishi mumkin, chunki mamlakat allaqachon qon banklarida qonning surunkali tanqisligiga duch kelmoqda. Qonga bo'lgan talab ortib bormoqda, chunki ko'plab zamonaviy tibbiy va jarrohlik muolajalari sezilarli miqdorda qon talab qiladi. Shu bilan birga, kamroq odamlar qon topshirishga tayyor bo'lib tuyuladi.

Britaniya Milliy Qon Xizmati o'zining qon ta'minotining xavfsizligini himoya qildi va qon donorlarini tekshirish kabi qattiq chora-tadbirlar mavjudligini ta'kidladi. Biroq, jamoatchilik qon quyish orqali OIV yuqtirganlarni eslaydi va bu saqlanib qolgan qo'rquv, hatto u asoslanmagan bo'lsa ham, saqlanib qoladi. Bu vaziyat qon xavfsizligi borasida hushyorlik va shaffoflik zarurligini ta'kidlaydi. Bu qon ta'minotining yetarli bo'lishini ta'minlash va jamoatchilikning tizimga bo'lgan ishonchini saqlash o'rtasidagi nozik muvozanatdir. Shuningdek, biz qon xavfsizligiga yangi tahdidlar paydo bo'lishi mumkinligini tan olishimiz kerak. Qon ta'minotini xavfsiz saqlash uchun tegishli tadqiqotlar va sinovlar muhim ahamiyatga ega.
mock_data.translationC1:
Qon quyish ko'pincha hayotni saqlab qoluvchi aralashuv sifatida e'zozlanadi, ammo ularning yuqumli kasalliklarni yuqtirishdagi potentsial roli haqida tobora ortib borayotgan xavotirlar paydo bo'ldi. Bu xavotir tibbiyot sohasidagi taniqli shaxslarning yaqinda qilgan bayonotlari bilan kuchaytirildi.

Amerika Qizil Xoch Jamiyatining prezidenti Bernadette Healey yaqinda hatto favqulodda vaziyatda ham Buyuk Britaniyada qon quyishdan o'zini tiyishini aytdi. Uning xavotirlari, ayniqsa, xavfli va zaiflashtiruvchi nevrologik kasallik bo'lgan Creutzfeldt-Jakob kasalligining (vCJD) variantini yuqtirish xavfidan kelib chiqqan.

Creutzfeldt-Jakob kasalligi, uning turli shakllarida, kam uchraydigan va doimiy ravishda o'limga olib keladigan, miyaning tez buzilishini tezlashtiradigan holatdir. Variant shakli, vCJD, odatda "sigir telbasi" kasalligi sifatida tanilgan Bovine Spongiform Encephalopathy (BSE) bilan kasallangan qoramol go'shtini iste'mol qilish bilan bog'liq. 1986 yilda Britaniyada birinchi marta paydo bo'lgan BSE, kasallangan hayvonlarda nevrologik buzilishga olib keladi, bu esa harakatlarning muvofiqlashtirilmasligiga va oxir-oqibatda qulashga olib keladi.

Katta tadqiqotlarga qaramay, vCJD yuqishining aniq mexanizmlari noaniqlik pardasi ostida qolmoqda. Muhimi, hozirgi kunga qadar qon quyish orqali vCJD yuqishi bo'yicha hech qanday hujjatlashtirilgan holat yo'q. Bunday yuqish mumkinmi yoki yo'qmi degan savol aniq ilmiy tasdiqni chetlab o'tadi. Biroq, ehtimol, qanchalik uzoq bo'lmasin, jamoatchilik xavotirini kuchaytirishda davom etmoqda.

Xavotir vCJD ning asemptomatik tashuvchilari bilmagan holda qon topshirishi va shu bilan patogenni qon ta'minotiga kiritishi mumkinligi bilan bog'liq. Ushbu xavotirlarga javoban, Amerika Qizil Xoch Jamiyati, Qo'shma Shtatlarda qon quyish uchun qonning asosiy yetkazib beruvchisi, Evropada yashagan yoki ko'p sayohat qilgan shaxslarga qon topshirishni taqiqlash siyosatini joriy qildi.

Potentsial donorlarga qo'yilgan ushbu cheklov allaqachon xavfli vaziyatni yanada og'irlashtirishi mumkin. Qo'shma Shtatlar o'zining qon banklarida qonning doimiy yetishmasligi bilan kurashmoqda, bu muammo ilg'or tibbiy va jarrohlik muolajalarda qonga bo'lgan talabning ortishi va ko'ngilli qon topshirish darajasining pasayishi bilan murakkablashadi. Ushbu omillarning o'zaro ta'siri sog'liqni saqlash xodimlari uchun qiyin dinamikani yaratadi.

Britaniya Milliy Qon Xizmati o'zining qon ta'minotining xavfsizligini qat'iy himoya qildi, ifloslanishdan himoya qilish uchun joriy etilgan qat'iy skrining protokollari va boshqa ehtiyot choralarini ta'kidladi. Shunga qaramay, o'tmishdagi holatlarning umumiy xotirasi, xususan, OIVning qon quyish orqali yuqishi, xavfsizlik kafolatlariga qaramay, jamoatchilik xavotirini uzoq soyadek tashlashda davom etmoqda. Muammo shundan iboratki, saboqlar o'rganilganligi va shunga o'xshash hodisalar xavfi, agar butunlay yo'q qilinmagan bo'lsa, ishontirishga qaratilgan, inson qodir bo'lganicha.
